lexicon.0.0001 ZEC: zero point zero zero zero one [ZEC](/zˈɛk/)

segments.name: e4-open

params.title: Your first shielded transaction
params.line: Zodl was called Zashi in older guides

narration: By the end of this video, you will have sent and received your first shielded payment, with a private note.

segments.name: e4-receive
narration: Every payment has two sides. Let's start with receiving.
To get paid, tap Receive. Copy your Zcash Shielded Address. It starts with u1.
Send it to the person paying you. They can also scan it if you tap QR Code.

segments.name: e4-send

params.label: Diagram, not the app
params.definition: Note: a private message that travels with a shielded payment

narration: Now sending. Tap Send. Paste the address into Send to, then type the amount.
In Message, you can add a note. A note is a private message that travels with the payment. Only you and the person you pay can read it.

segments.name: e4-confirm
narration: Before anything is sent, Zodl shows the Confirmation screen. Check the address and the fee.
Zcash fees follow a public rule called ZIP 317. The smallest fee is 0.0001 ZEC.
Tap Send. When Zodl shows Sent!, your first shielded payment is on its way.

segments.name: e4-arrive
narration: On your friend's phone, the payment arrives with your note. Only the two of you can read it.
Ask them to send a little back to your u1 address. Now you have received a shielded payment too.

segments.name: e4-chain
narration: And what does the blockchain show? Only scrambled data. Not who paid. Not who got paid. Not how much. Not the note.

segments.name: e4-site
narration: Tick Sending and Receiving on the site to finish your checklist.

segments.name: e4-end
narration: Episode 5 shows five habits that keep it private. Find it at zero-to-shielded.vercel.app.

upload.title: Sending and receiving: your first shielded transaction | Zero to Shielded 4
upload.description:
Send and receive your first shielded payment in Zodl, with a private note. Shielded means the amount, the sender and the receiver are encrypted on the blockchain. This is episode 4 of Zero to Shielded.

Watch the series and tick your progress: https://zero-to-shielded.vercel.app

In this episode:
- Receiving: tap Receive and copy your Zcash Shielded Address. It starts with u1. The person paying you can also scan it if you tap QR Code.
- Sending: tap Send. Paste the address into Send to, then type the amount.
- In Message you can add a note. A note is a private message that travels with the payment. Only you and the person you pay can read it.
- Tap Review. Zodl shows the Confirmation screen with the fee before anything is sent. Zcash fees follow a public rule called ZIP 317. The smallest fee is 0.0001 ZEC.
- Tap Send. When Zodl shows Sent!, your first shielded payment is on its way.
- What the blockchain shows: only scrambled data. Not who paid. Not who got paid. Not how much. Not the note.

Chapters:
{chapters}

Wallet steps are shown as labelled step diagrams with the exact button names from the Zodl app, not as drawings of the app. Every fact is sourced in docs/FACTS.md. No recovery phrase appears on screen.

Zodl was called Zashi in older guides.

Zodl: https://zodl.com/
Zodl support: https://support.zodl.com/

Video, narration and script: CC BY-ND 4.0. Repost with credit, no edits.

Scripts, narration and editing were produced with AI assistance (Kiro). Narration is a synthesised voice (Kokoro, Apache-2.0). Music is original and generated in code.
